::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/transfer_configurations/{job}/items"}
#docs
One page of the run's items in plan order, each in the shape of the run's `items`. Filters combine. A result is what the plan does with the item: a left-out item is `left_out` and a blocked one `blocked`, whatever its action.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `job` | `string` | **yes** | The transfer job's id. |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `section` | `string` | no | Only this section, e.g. `coupons`. |
| `result` | `string` | no | Only items with this result. `changes` is the items that write to the destination: `new`, `updated` and `deleted`. |
| `status` | `string` | no | Only items the apply queued: all of them (`queued`), the ones not done yet (`open`), or one status. |
| `q` | `string` | no | Only items whose label contains this text, in any case. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of items to return. Default 100. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The `next_cursor` of the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items: `key`, `pair`, `section`, `kind`, `label`, `action`, `excluded`, `blocked`, `depends_on`, `diff`, `messages`, `status`, `skip_reason`, `error`, `attempts`, `started_at`, `finished_at`. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | True when there are more items after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` for the next page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | A page of items |
| `400` | Invalid query |
| `403` | Requires an all-mode API key |
| `404` | No such transfer |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/transfer_configurations/Job/items?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
